chunk_text: LONG-LIVING MOTHER. If the 4th house is occupied by a benefic while its lord is in his exaltation sign and the indicator of mother is endowed with strength, the native will have a long-living mother.

chunk_text: HAPPINESS TO MOTHER.. The native's mother will be happy if the 4th lord is in an angle while Venus is also in an angle as Mercury is exalted.

chunk_text: QUADRUPEDS .. The Sun in the 4th, Moon and Saturn in the 9th and Mars in the 11th - this yoga will confer cows and buffaloes on the native.

chunk_text: DUMBNESS .. Should the 4th house be a movable one while its lord and Mars are together in the 6th or the 8th house, the native will be dumb.

chunk_text: CONVEYANCES.. If the ascendant lord is a benefic while the 4th lord is in fall or in the 11th and the significator (Venus) is in the 12th, the native will obtain conveyances in his 12th year.
